reference_sql:
SELECT category_id,
       ROUND(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY unit_cost_eur), 0) AS median_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE category_id BETWEEN 15 AND 20
GROUP BY category_id
alternatives:
SELECT DISTINCT category_id,
       ROUND(MEDIAN(unit_cost_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id), 0) AS median_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE category_id BETWEEN 15 AND 20

SELECT category_id, ROUND(MEDIAN(unit_cost_eur), 0) AS median_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE category_id BETWEEN 15 AND 20
GROUP BY category_id

other_way.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT category_id,
       ROUND(MEDIAN(unit_cost_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id), 0) AS median_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE category_id BETWEEN 15 AND 20
other_way.tradeoff: MEDIAN over a window puts the median on every product row, so it needs DISTINCT to give one row per category.
